Reader / Implementation planFictional demo

Save a link now and read it later

Start with a small local reading list. Save a URL, add a title and mark the item as read. Keep article downloads outside this first change.

Implementation order

  1. Store the list. Use a stable ID, URL, title, saved date and read state.
  2. Add the form. Validate HTTP and HTTPS URLs. Keep the typed title if page metadata cannot be read.
  3. Show saved items. Put unread items first, then sort by saved date.
  4. Verify persistence. Save two items, mark one as read and reopen the app.

Should saving an existing URL reopen its item or move it to the top? Reopening preserves the original saved date.
